title: Argument bound in an unrolled circuit
statement: Let $M$ be a sequential circuit with $n$ inputs and $r$ registers, and let $p$ be a natural number. Every vertex index appearing among the arguments of the gate at position $p$ in the unrolled circuit is less than $n+p$.
hypotheses_covered: A sequential circuit $M$ with parameters $n$ and $r$
